WITH scoped AS (
SELECT f.*,o.side AS order_side,o.action AS order_action,o.limit_price,o.raw_order_json::jsonb AS raw_order
FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id
AND o.id=(SELECT min(x.id) FROM live_orders x WHERE x.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id)
WHERE o.strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%')
SELECT raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'outcome_side' AS fill_outcome,raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'book_side' AS fill_book,
raw_order->>'outcome_side' AS order_outcome,raw_order->>'book_side' AS order_book,
count(*) AS fills,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE (raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'no_price_dollars')::numeric=price/100.0) AS no_price_matches,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE (raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'yes_price_dollars')::numeric+(raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'no_price_dollars')::numeric=1) AS complementary_prices,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE price<=limit_price) AS no_limit_respected,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE raw_order->>'order_id'=kalshi_order_id) AS exchange_order_id_matches,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE coalesce(raw_order->>'ticker',raw_order->>'market_ticker')=market_ticker) AS exchange_order_ticker_matches
FROM scoped GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY fills DESC
